hero.headline:
If it stops working,
we replace it.
hero.sub: $t(term.label) on the instruments, on top of the 30-day money-back window. You do not send the dead one back.

covered.title: What is covered
items: Manufacturing defects and failure in normal use, for $t(term.long) from delivery.
If any individual diode stops emitting light, the instrument is covered. One diode — not “half the panel”, not “materially degraded performance”.
The controller, the charger and the cable. In this category these fail more often than the diodes do.
We cover shipping in both directions.

excluded.title: What is not covered
items: The gels and pads — they are consumables.
Wear that does not affect function.

items.title: Send one photo
items.desc: Email info@zentialpure.com with a photo of the instrument switched on in a dark room, and your order number. That is the whole diagnosis.

items.title: A human replies within one business day
items.desc: A real person, not a form. If we miss that, it is our failure and not a reason to close your claim.

items.title: We ship a replacement
items.desc: Dispatched within three business days of the decision. You keep the old unit — we do not ask you to return a device that does not work.

items.title: Or a refund, if you prefer
items.desc: Processed within five business days. No restocking fee, no inspection, no questionnaire.

statutory.title: Your legal rights come first, and they are larger than this
statutory.body: This warranty is IN ADDITION to your statutory rights and does not limit them in any way. Consumers in the EU have a legal conformity right of at least two years. In the Netherlands there is no fixed cap at all — the wettelijke garantie runs for as long as the product can reasonably be expected to last, which may be considerably longer than $t(term.labelLower). Nothing on this page shortens that, and if the law gives you more than we do, the law wins.

cta.headline: Something not working?
cta.sub: One email, one photo. We handle the rest.
